## Outcome

My first coding week began with a CI failure that appeared across unrelated pull requests. The R and JavaScript coverage jobs were using the same temporary GitHub Pages repository, so either job could delete it while the other was still running.

[PR #330](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/330) gave each job its own repository and merged on May 25. Later in the week, [PR #292](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/292)—the legend opt-out work I had started before GSoC—also merged.

## Context

PR #292 began before GSoC. This week I completed its remaining review cycle. It provided the first opt-out behavior, but its limitations later led to Issue #333 and PR #336.

## What I Did

- Merged PR #330 on May 25 after separating the repositories used by `R_coverage`, `JS_coverage`, and local runs.
- Addressed four review comments on [PR #288](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/288) and kept its regression test focused on custom output heights.
- Revised [PR #285](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/285) so an invalid facet variable produces a useful error instead of failing later with a generic message.
- Finished the review cycle for PR #292, which merged on May 28.

## Learnings

I had been adding a failing test first because that pattern worked well for behavior fixes. Toby pointed out that a PR whose purpose is already testing or CI does not need an artificial red first commit. That small review comment changed how I structured later infrastructure work.

## Challenges / Notes

The facet-height test passed through browser layout and could succeed for the wrong reason if unrelated setup changed. I had to remove those accidental influences before trusting the assertion.

## Next Week Targets

Design a narrower replacement for PR #292 that preserves an explicit `showSelected` value while disabling only automatic legend-variable injection.

<iframe src="/journal/week-1/week1-legend-optout-demo/index.html" title="Interactive comparison of default legend filtering and the PR 292 opt-out behavior" loading="lazy"></iframe>

Click a legend entry. The default plot filters to the selected series; the PR #292 plot keeps both series visible while preserving the legend. This is intentionally rendered with the August 24 cutoff environment because PR #336 retired `showSelected = character()` on August 25.

<details class="demo-code">
<summary>View the essential R code</summary>

```r
animint(
  default = ggplot(test_data, aes(x, y, colour = comparison)) +
    geom_point(),
  optedout = ggplot(test_data, aes(x, y, colour = comparison)) +
    geom_point(showSelected = character()),
  selector.types = list(comparison = "single")
)
```

</details>
